description: Declaring the whole prose command `pnpm test before each push` passes REF-001, but in plain text a command must equal a known-command form exactly or appear in an excerpt, so REF-003 rejects it.
section: IMPL §3.3.5 step 7 (REF-003: arguments are allowed only for commands in code; developer decision, fails closed)

recommendations.content: The suite runs with pnpm test before each push.
recommendations.rationale: The manifest defines the test script.
